positions.title: Text-to-Speech Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed two expressive voices for speech synthesis by: implementing sentence-selection algorithms and developing a corpus of recordings for speech synthesis, designing phonetic data conversion system from in-house proprietary file format to public format to facilitate phonetic labeling and segmentation outsourcing, and overseeing an external team of labelers.

positions.title: TEFL Volunteer
positions.description:
-Served in Klouekanme, Benin (West Africa)
-Taught English to middle- and high-school level classes.
-Wrote a learner's guide to Ajagbe (the dominant language in Klouekanme)
-Wrote a grammar of Ajagbe

positions.title: Student Researcher for the Washo Project
positions.description: The Washo Project is concerned with documenting the Washo language (a moribund Native American language spoken around Lake Tahoe). It is led by Professor Alan Yu at the University of Chicago. I helped to compile a Washo-English dictionary and did research work studying the stress system of the language.
